result.instructions:
Odin is a local Rust code-intelligence service. Every call is scoped to a configured project ID; there is no process-global active project. Start with project_analysis for live project structure and backend gaps, then get_symbols_overview/find_symbol; read bodies only when needed. LSP positions use zero-based lines and UTF-16 columns; read_file/line edits use one-based inclusive lines. Read the SHA-256 first. All native source edits return an immutable transaction preview; use transaction_apply only after reviewing it. Successful application is NOT a passing build: run an authorized build/test profile and inspect its actual exit status. Native JSON flow is a bounded dataflow, not Python eval. This standalone build has no external tool bridge. Semantic operations connect directly to configured language servers; debugging connects directly to configured DAP adapters. Missing features have no hidden fallback. Missing capabilities are errors, never fabricated successful results.
